rationale: The Court is most likely to issue a narrow Erie/Hanna/Walker opinion holding Delaware’s AOM enforceable in diversity because no Federal Rule is sufficiently broad to displace a claim-specific condition on maintaining a state-created malpractice action. Separate writings are most likely from the dissenters (to press the “direct collision” view) and from Thomas/Gorsuch (to emphasize original-meaning/REA limits on construing transsubstantive Rules to preempt state remedial conditions).
